BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 72 read with Section 71 of the Finance Act, No. 11 of 1963, I, RaviKarunanayake, Minister of Finance, do by this Order, vest in the People’s Bank established under the People’s Bank Act,No. 29 of 1961, with effect from 31st January two thousand and seventeen, the properties described in the Schedulehereto.

1. All that divided and defined allotment of land marked as Lot 3 called as “Udugamage Watta” depicted in Plan No.1587 dated 29.07.1993 made by Licensed Surveyor D. Rathnayaka, situated at Bathambure in the Grama NiladhariDivision of Bathambure bearing No. 10A in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Rambukkana, in Medde MediliyaPattu in Kinigoda Korale in the District of Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded on the North by Lot02 on the East by Panuambagahamula Watta and live fence, on The South by Lot 04 and on the West by DivungaleWatta claimed by D. M. Karunarathna and others and Lot 02 in extent of thiry three perches (00A., 0R., 33P.)together with trees and everything else standing thereon.
This land is registered in folio B 399/48 in the Land Registry, Kegalle.
